note: #2767 item 10 (a non-"1"-starting ordered-list marker wrongly interrupts a paragraph): the inline maintainer-decision pattern's block-start guard rejects ANY digit-led ordered marker on the hard-wrapped resolution line, regardless of the starting digit -- but CommonMark only lets a marker starting at "1" interrupt an open paragraph; a "5." continuation is ordinary lazy-continuation prose. findIndentedCodeRanges's own isNonInterruptingListItem already encodes the correct CommonMark rule elsewhere in this same codebase, but resolved-decision.mts's guard has no equivalent exception, so a genuinely resolved decision whose resolution text happens to start with a non-"1" numbered continuation is wrongly rejected as an empty marker. The gap is present today (MATCH).
title: Keep numbering as before
body:
Whether this design reads well is ultimately a matter of maintainer preference.

Maintainer decision (#100, 2026-09-01):
5. Keep numbering the remaining steps as before, no change needed.
